slides.dek: Four colours, one strict split. Every hex code inside.

slides.name: Warm Alabaster
slides.body: Every wall, plus the ceiling. Warmer than builder white, so lamplight lands soft instead of clinical.

slides.name: Greige
slides.body: Sofa, curtains, the rug field. Grey brings the restraint, beige brings the warmth, and the room stops fighting itself.

slides.name: Umber
slides.body: Coffee table, picture frames, shelf edges. Dark wood anchors the scheme. Skip it and the palette floats away.

slides.name: Aged Brass
slides.body: Lamp stems, cabinet handles, one tray. Ten percent is the ceiling. Brass past that point tips from warm into loud.

body: Sixty percent walls, thirty percent large pieces, ten percent accent. Rooms that read expensive keep the split strict.
One thing to keep out: chrome. It argues with brass and wins nothing.
